kept_back.rule: kept back for the earlier maintainer's AJILE12 line (lead decision of 27 November 2026); never downloaded or opened by this track

E2.rule: participants 03-07; calibration = lowest-numbered session; scoring = next-numbered session
E2.window_rule: for k = 0, 1, 2, ...: candidate issue frame = int(sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|ajile12|' + participant + '|ses-' + session + '|' + k), 16) mod n_frames; accept if eligible (protocol section 7.2) and at least 2 s from every accepted issue time; stop at 600 accepted or k = 200000

leave_one_dataset_out.rule: each wave-1 dataset in turn is left out of training; its adapter is fitted on its inner-training units and scored on its inner-validation units

not_used.b1: the Gait120 validation and confirmation people's unopened tasks stay unopened (lead decision of 27 November 2026)
not_used.ibl: IBL Brain-Wide Map stays with the earlier maintainer: no IBL subject, lab or session is used for training or testing (lead decision of 27 November 2026); there is no E4

d_arms.rule: for k in {2,4,8} and draw in {0,1,2}: order candidate sources by ascending sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|D|k' + k + '|draw' + draw + '|' + dataset); the arm uses the first k sources in that order that are eligible (at least W_max/8 inner-training windows, counted at P2)

quantity_diversity.d_candidate_note: conditional sources (area2, falcon_m1) join the candidate list only if admitted before the freeze; the orders are then recomputed with the same rule and recorded in MIXTURE-MANIFEST.json

ds003739.rule: rank inner-training people by ascending sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|P|' + dataset + '|' + unit); level L takes the first L (nested); levels = max(2, round(n/16)), round(n/4) and n, rounding halves up

gait120.rule: rank inner-training people by ascending sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|P|' + dataset + '|' + unit); level L takes the first L (nested); levels = max(2, round(n/16)), round(n/4) and n, rounding halves up

quantity_diversity.p_window_rule: W_P = the largest power of 2 not above min(W_max/4, windows of the smallest P level of that dataset); each P arm draws W_P windows, equal shares per person as far as available, in the q_window_rule order
quantity_diversity.q_window_rule: within an anchor's inner-training units, order its non-overlapping 1.2 s windows by ascending sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|Q|' + dataset + '|' + window_id) and take the first W (nested levels W_max/16, W_max/4, W_max)
quantity_diversity.w_max_rule: W_max = the smallest number of unique inner-training windows in any Q anchor, rounded down to a power of 2 (computed at P2 from MIXTURE-MANIFEST.json)
